name: Quest Change Executor
description: A quest changes exactly as the person asked.
purpose: Change a quest exactly as the person asked, once.
approach: Plan the operation from the request, perform only the named operation through the writer, and read the final state back.
out_of_scope: Whether a change needs the person's decision (Quest Decision Requests); which data to read (Quest Context).
milestones: 1. Quest records, ambiguous messages and unconfirmed deletes are scored on final-state cases.
measures_of_success: The final state of the quest matches the request on scripted cases: everything asked, nothing else, once.
inputs: A request that asks for a change to a quest.
outputs: The change made and the state read back.
effects: Writes to the person's quest through the Quest client or an allowlisted tool server.
usage_notes: A change that needs the person goes to Quest Decision Requests first.

name: Detect A Stalled Run
description: A run is stopped only when it is truly stuck.
purpose: Tells a stuck run from a slow one by reading its live activity, so stuck work stops and slow work finishes.
approach: Reads a run's live activity log and decides whether it should keep running or stop.
out_of_scope: Stopping a run because it has taken a long time, and judging whether a run achieved its goal.
milestones: 1. Stop-or-continue verdicts match hand-labelled live logs with zero false stops at each re-score.
knowledge: A wrong stop loses work that was about to land, so the reviewer fails open: any problem reaching or reading it means keep running. A quiet parent log while a subagent works is real work. Builds, tests and downloads look idle but are alive. A rule floor written with the cases in view is an optimistic ceiling for a rule, not a blind result.
measures_of_success: Verdicts match hand-labelled logs, with no false stops and few missed stops, and the unreadable-verdict case degrades to keep running.
parameters: Review interval, review model, call timeout, and the prompt template with elapsed time, idle time and log tail.
inputs: Elapsed run time, time since the log last changed, and a tail of the session activity.
outputs: A verdict of stop or keep running with a one-sentence reason, and a usage-limit signal when relevant.
effects: One small model call per review for a model-based reviewer; the verdict triggers a stop of the worker.
usage_notes: Review periodically, skip the model when a subagent is plainly working, and treat an unreadable verdict as keep running. Re-score with held-out logs whenever the prompt changes.
